verdict.rationale: Mercury's official mercury-skills repo lists a first-party `mercury-detect-anomaly` agent skill that drives the Mercury CLI. That is the product's own AI-oriented anomaly-detection capability, but the evidence is only a skill name, with no description of what it flags or how. It is also agent-invoked rather than shown to run automatically, and spend limits and approval queues are policy controls rather than AI flagging, so they earn no credit. Missing for 10: documented always-on automatic flagging, out-of-policy detection tied to spend rules, routing of flagged transactions into a review queue, detailed docs on the skill's behavior, independent or hands-on corroboration.
